title: City positions paid above the top of the Human Resources pay scale
question: In 2025, which City positions were paid regular pay well above the highest rate the Department of Human Resources publishes for that job title?
finding: Of 40,298 City rows in the State export for 2025, 37,027 carry a job title found in the Department of Human Resources rate table for fiscal 2025-26 (1,067 titles). 366 of them had regular pay more than 10% and $10,000 above 26 times the highest biweekly maximum listed for that title; 155 of them are rows that also name a second position, whose regular pay may include the second job, most in Public Health (159), Fire Department (76), Police (45). Largest: Senior Physician Specialist (Public Health), $602,798 against a top of $364,728.
how: Job titles in the State export are matched word for word (ignoring case) to titles in the rate table; where a title has several rates the highest biweekly maximum is used, which already includes the January 2026 increase, so the test is generous to the employee. Rows whose title does not match are left out.
limits: Regular pay in a calendar or fiscal year can include retroactive pay, a 27th pay period, acting assignment pay at a higher class, premiums the City folds into salary, or pay for two jobs under one title. The Compensation Manual lists the same classes with ranges and premiums. A row is a question, not an overpayment.

columns.t: Top of the scale for a year

sources.t: California State Controller: Government Compensation in California, raw exports 2019 to 2025
